title: Roxybar Winter Village
desc: Una stazione invernale molto suggestiva con due seggiovie discese con la carrucola e lo slittino  una pista di pattinaggio lunghissima un caldo chalet con giochi e la deliziosa spa. A  very beautiful winter village with ice skating on the frozen lake, sleigh rides, a small alpine church, and warm huts.

title: Adagio's Winterland
desc: A dreamy, snowy haven wrapped in soft drifts, shimmering lights, and warm winter charm. Explore rentals and photo spots, join snowball fights, ride horses or unicorns, go sledding or snowmobiling, enjoy singles or couples skating, karaoke twice weekly, and visit Santa and Mrs. Claus at their charming holiday home.

title: Winterhaven
desc: Winterhaven is a holiday-themed destination, part of the Mythbehaven land project in Corsica. Skiing, ice skating, sledding, board games, streaming entertainment, and Mystory furniture and sundries are all available free of charge to the public. Park your vehicle and walk, ride a horse, bicycle, or go-kart to explore all the Havens, which are also GTFO hubs!

title: The Bivouac
desc:
A cozy, eclectic space with beautiful year-round snowy views. Plenty of comfy spots to enjoy some time on your way up the mountain.
Enjoy access to the ski lift. It's always snowing, and the drinks will warm your bones.

title: Malaika Park
desc: This recreation of Rockefeller Center at Malaika Park during Christmas time will remind you of a time when life was simpler. Grab a roasted chestnut or a hot chocolate after ice skating on the plaza. The store windows are all decorated for the season and there are free gifts for everyone.

title: North Pole Village & Santa's Workshop
desc: North Pole Village and Santa's Workshop is an immersive holiday experience designed after fairy tales, folklore, and stories about the North Pole and Santa. The Village contains everything from a North Pole Post Office to the "Better Watch Out!" coal mine to an Elf Command Center, as well as Santa’s Workshop, where the elves are busily making toys.

title: FlyGearZ Tyme
desc: FlyGearZ Tyme offers a two-region winter festival with steampunk touches, scenic paths, and plenty to explore. Visitors can enjoy horses, sledding, ice skating, dancing, FlyGearZ performances, cozy cuddle spots, and themed photo ops. Seasonal Valentine touches include heart-shaped balloon tours and romantic corners throughout the region.

title: The Winter Garden at Akijima
desc: Discover The Winter Garden at Akijima, an enchanting holiday escape. This snowy, magical park offers a region-wide experience with photogenic scenes. Glide on ice skating rinks, dance in a ballroom, and find hidden snuggle spots amidst serene vistas. Capture unforgettable memories in this charming wonderland filled with festive magic and cozy corners, perfect for a truly immersive winter adventure.

title: Flyte at FlyGearZ
desc: Flyte at FlyGearZ presents a reimagined two-region winter festival featuring steampunk details, land and water attractions, tours, new venues, an information hub, art galleries, a village, horseback riding, sledding, ice skating, live entertainment with FlyGearZ shows, photo opportunities, and quiet spots for couples.

title: Green Story
desc: Green Story is a peaceful and charming place, especially beautiful when it rains. It’s a perfect spot for couples seeking a romantic date, offering a quiet and intimate atmosphere. The location is also ideal for photography, with stunning, tranquil views that make for beautiful photos. Whether you’re looking to relax or capture the moment, Green Story offers the perfect setting. It's currently dressed for winter.

title: The Brittle Epoch by Bryn Oh
desc: A young girl named Flutter begins a new journey in The Brittle Epoch, which is part two of "Hand" by Bryn Oh. For more info, visit brynoh.blogspot.com

title: Evolving Images Snow Park
desc: Come visit Evolving Images Romantic Park & Wildlife Reserve. Take a romantic walk or go slow dancing in the moonlight. There's also ice skating on the frozen lake and plenty of photo ops. Sip coffee and munch on toasted chestnuts at the coffee shop. Stroll through our romantic forest and bird sanctuary. Visit the nativity scene or meditate in the oriental gardens. Don't forget to ride Santa's sleigh!
